note: Mostly seasonal and annual campers, who are guaranteed a site; overnight sites are first come subject to availability. A private park on a ridge about a mile from the Alligator 1 and 2 boat launches on Lake Cumberland, with a swimming pool, a fishing pond and rental cabins. Some recent reviews note upkeep slipping under newer owners. --Claude
summary: Kept with long-stay flag. $40 overnight confirmed (undated operator rate page), electric included; 57 sites FHU; laundry/bath house/pool; year-round. Mostly seasonal/annual (operator guarantees seasonal sites; overnight 'subject to availability'; summer imagery shows nearly every pad holding a parked travel trailer). Google 4.9/22. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: LONG-STAY (drop candidate for the reviewer, borderline): rv.html 'Overnight & Monthly RV Sites are subject to availability. Seasonal & Annual RV Campers are guaranteed a site.' Rates offered: monthly $375 in season / $175 off-season, seasonal $1525, annual $1725. Home page counters 'We are open year round for the RV overnighter, with several large sites always available.' On Esri summer imagery about 35-40 of the 57 pads hold travel trailers with sheds/decks typical of seasonal setups; I count only a handful of empty pads, so the nightly share looks under ~20%. Iffy signs: the site is ©2017-styled and undated, 'Now under new ownership', and the previous note recorded reviews of slipping upkeep; Google is 4.9 stars on only 22 reviews. Note now says mostly seasonal.
Price gate passes: $40 overnight with electric included (rv.html, undated; same figure as the 2026-10-16 read).
'ATVs Allowed' is a park rule, not an OHV trail-base park; not an OHV flag.
Google lists it as 'Pine Crest RV Park & Resort' with a pin 37.00334,-84.93741, ~350 m W of the sites; stored pin 37.0026,-84.9337 is on the site rows; no move.
Not waterfront confirmed: the park is on a ridge ~1 mile from the lake; no change.
